scope: Static inspection only; no native runtime or full cross-system scenario execution

findings.detail: Activation deletes all cache names except ucad-shell-r1; cache cleanup must be scoped to caches owned by UCAD. Fixed shell namespace requires real prior-version upgrade test. Network-first behavior differs from PulseX cache-first; do not equate stale-shell reproduction.
findings.required_test: Populate unrelated caches and pending IndexedDB data; activate new worker; assert preservation; upgrade actual previous bundle; test online/offline/reconnect without duplicates.

findings.detail: This gate counts registries and validates keys. It does not execute business journeys; PASS cannot alone prove operational acceptance. Other gates have not been fully reviewed.
